summary: Stonepeak-Plus Infrastructure Fund LP filed a Form 8-K reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership units under Items 3.02 and 8.01. On June 1, 2026, it sold 577,540 Class A-1a, 15,729 Class A-1c, 290,313 Class Z-Series I-2, and 2,982 Class Z-Series S-2 units to third-party investors for aggregate consideration of approximately $28,996,500 at transactional NAV per unit as of May 31, 2026. The sales were part of a continuous private offering exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. No strategic event, recommendation, or structural change is involved.
